highlights.title: Sign in with ChatGPT
highlights.description: Connect your ChatGPT account through browser OAuth to use eligible plan models without an API key. Credentials stay in the OS keyring and are shared across your ChatGPT configs.

highlights.title: Model-aware thinking effort
highlights.description: Provider settings now let you pick a thinking effort level matched to what each model actually supports, balancing speed and depth.

highlights.title: Faster launch, library, and EPUB reading
highlights.description: Deferred startup work and catalog prefetching shorten launch time, library queries take a faster top-k path, and EPUB loading and layout respond quicker.

highlights.title: Safer startup settings and updated presets
highlights.description: Fixed startup update checks overwriting concurrent settings saves, replaced the deprecated Kimi K2.6 default preset, and updated DashScope and Volcengine output limits.
